name: M.I.N.S.K.
description:
About This Game

M.I.N.S.K. is a third-person survival horror adventure set in a dark, post-apocalyptic world.
You control an android created by a lone engineer struggling to survive. The cities are shrouded in toxic fog, and the last remnants of civilization hide in the towering ruins above. But when the android encounters another robot—controlled by a biologist searching for answers—their connection sparks something deeper than just survival.

Now, they share a common goal: to reunite in the real world and uncover the truth behind the devastation. But between them stand treacherous landscapes, hostile machines, and ruthless scavengers who will do anything to take what little remains.

--

🛠 Key Features

  • A Thoughtfully Crafted Experience
    Designed by a passionate small team, M.I.N.S.K. offers a seamless and immersive experience where every aspect—from gameplay to storytelling—blends harmoniously. Expect a refined adventure that balances exploration, action, and emotional depth.

  • A Deep, Emotional Storyline
    Step into a world filled with loneliness, hope, and love. Experience a story that unfolds through the interactions between humans and machines, where choices and relationships shape the journey in unexpected ways.

  • AAA-Level Visuals & Immersive Sound Design
    Explore stunningly detailed environments brought to life with cutting-edge Unreal Engine 5 technology. From towering ruins to eerie, fog-covered streets, every location is filled with rich visual storytelling, complemented by an atmospheric soundtrack that deepens the immersion.

  • A Unique Vertical Level Design
    Venture through a city structured across multiple layers—each with distinct challenges, dangers, and mysteries. Climb, explore, and adapt as you traverse this intricate world, uncovering secrets hidden in the depths of the ruins.
short_desc: In a world on the brink of extinction, survivors hide from the toxic fog. Control an exploration robot as it infiltrates abandoned locations in search of vital resources.
